title: Resolver aggregate-depth adjustment

scope.rationale: Alias resolution now uses the source walker callback and guarded driver to increase aggregate-function nesting depth.

dependencies.caller_closure: Production resolveAlias calls the driver for duplicated aggregate expressions.

inputs: Expression tree and integer depth increment
outputs: Every TK_AGG_FUNCTION op2 increased by positive increment
contracts.state_and_results: Zero/negative increments are no-ops; walker always continues through expressions.

representation_differences: Walker.u.counter stores the increment through the typed union arm.

oracle.protocol: Adjust nested aggregate/non-aggregate expression trees with negative, zero, one, and larger increments.

assurance.malformed_input: Nullable root accepted; source op2 range invariants apply.
assurance.performance: Linear expression walk for positive increments; constant no-op otherwise.

integration.bounded_owner_retired: Manual recursive substitute replaced by source walker behavior.

known_blockers: Focused nested-select differential and evidence-state promotion.

upstream_tests: Project resolver and broad runtime tests
